caption: The video showcases a blue toy train with a gray face and red trim resting on a green plastic track with rock-textured sides, set on a green cloth. An orange launcher arm stands in the adjacent groove just ahead of the train, and wooden blocks lie scattered in the background. For the opening portion of the clip the train stays put at this spot while the camera pulls back and pans right, gradually revealing a yellow-green elevated curved bridge that joins the green track. The train then starts to roll rightward along its lane, motion blur growing as it gathers speed, passing the stationary orange arm. It continues onto the yellow-green bridge, following the curve toward the right edge of the frame. There an orange structure rises into view, partly occluding the moving train as the excerpt ends. The camera's pan shifts the background blocks across the frame without any motion of their own.
